texte.Deux obligations qui se traitent avant l: Two obligations that are dealt with before deployment and become impossible to catch up afterwards.
texte.Deux référentiels, et le second n'est pa: Two frameworks, and the second is not one more standard: SP #-# OVERLAYS SP #-# for industry. Its Appendix G says so in so many words. This path takes them in the order in which they are built — the catalogue, then what the process adds to it — because the reverse has you reading a tailoring without knowing of what.
texte.Deux régimes peuvent obtenir un score vo: Two regimes can obtain a similar score by opposite routes — one demanding on data, the other on transparency. Read the dimensions, not only the total.

texte.Déclarez d’abord la criticité de la fonc: First declare the criticality of the function supported: as long as it is not declared, nothing is counted, because a rate on nine clauses when fifteen are due would be falsely reassuring. Then look at the two the authority opens first: the unrestricted right of audit (paragraph #, e) and the exit strategy (paragraph #, f).
texte.Déclarez la criticité, cochez les seuils: Declare the criticality, tick the thresholds reached, then timestamp awareness and classification. The clock has two limits: four hours from classification, twenty-four hours from awareness, whichever expires first governing. If classification occurs after those twenty-four hours, Article #(#) of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# deals with the case separately.
texte.Déclarez l’unité de facturation « requêt: Declare the billing unit “requests” where that is the case: systems billed per token will come out with hosting not counted, and the reporting will have to say so.
texte.Déclarez vos produits et choisissez leur: Declare your products and choose their class. Start with the one you are unsure about, not the simplest one.

Expand the category you are working on and use the points as a list of evidence to request. The statements are in English and verbatim, deliberately: a translated document can no longer be found in the source the day the auditor asks where it is written.
